events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Hands-on maintenance clinic for all skill levels. Topics include shifting issues, chain problems, brake rubbing, and valve core breaks. Participants will observe demonstrations then practice. Cost is $30. Rain or shine event. Dress in clothes you don't mind getting dirty. Bring your trail tools/kit. Check-in 4:30-5pm. Drink token and small snack provided. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test and tune event with industry partner Cane Creek Components. For all people with suspension bikes comfortable riding downhill on rocky/rooty trails. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. Bring riding clothes, pack, snacks, and water. No e-bikes allowed. First 8 emails register for spots. Email Dorene O'Malley to register. For all women 18 or older. Please allow other riders to participate if you have done a test + tune before.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery (342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712). Neither location allows e-bikes. Registration required through Eventbrite. Sign-up opens Sunday, November 1 at 7pm. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Group ride in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing (25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231). This location does not allow e-bikes. Registration required through Eventbrite. Sign-up opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7pm. For all women 18 or older.
